setup: none  -- multi-statement pins as elsewhere; Spark agreement measured in spark-ansi.json

pins.claim: String basics: upper/lower/reverse/length/bit_length/trim are character-based and NULL-propagating (measured identical in Spark)
pins.query: SELECT upper('héllo'), lower('HÉLLO'), reverse('ab☃'), length('é☃'), bit_length('é☃'), trim('  x  ')

pins.claim: contains/starts_with/instr: empty needle matches, 1-based positions, 0 on miss, NULL propagates (identical in Spark; starts_with spells startswith there)
pins.query: SELECT contains('abc',''), contains('abc','z'), starts_with('abc','ab'), instr('abcb','b'), instr('abc','z'), instr('abc','')

pins.claim: replace/repeat/translate: empty-from is a no-op, non-positive repeat is '', NULL propagates (identical in Spark)
pins.query: SELECT replace('aXbXc','X','-'), replace('abc','','-'), repeat('ab',3), repeat('ab',-1), translate('abcba','abc','xy')

pins.claim: concat SKIPS NULL arguments (Spark propagates - its printer wraps each argument in coalesce(x, '')); concat_ws skips NULL args but a NULL separator is NULL on both
Edit distances count BYTES: levenshtein('é','e') = 2 (Spark counts characters = 1; its printer refuses levenshtein and damerau_levenshtein by name)
